description: John Crichton is thrown through a wormhole into an unknown region of space and becomes part of Moya's fugitive crew, learning alien cultures while Peacekeeper commander Crais pursues them and Scorpius emerges as a far more dangerous enemy.

s01e01.description: Crichton's test flight is hurled through a wormhole, leaving him stranded aboard Moya with escaped alien prisoners and a furious Peacekeeper commander.

s01e02.description: Moya hides on an unfamiliar planet after a Peacekeeper beacon activates, while Crichton befriends a local family and searches for a way to silence it.

s01e03.description: An insect swarm infests Moya, copies the crew and drives the ship's temperature dangerously high as a Peacekeeper patrol closes in.

s01e04.description: Rygel is kidnapped by Tavlek mercenaries, forcing Crichton, Aeryn and D'Argo into an improvised rescue using the kidnappers' own weapon.

s01e05.description: Crichton begins seeing possible futures after contact with an Ilanic scientist, including visions that suggest betrayal and Moya's destruction.

s01e06.description: D'Argo and Zhaan become unnaturally devoted to a farming colony while Crichton investigates the drug keeping its workers content and Rygel becomes dangerously volatile.

s01e07.description: The crew boards an abandoned Peacekeeper vessel, where Aeryn reconnects with a technician from her past and Rygel confronts memories of captivity.

s01e08.description: The sorcerer Maldis traps Crichton and Crais in a psychic duel, feeding on their hatred while Zhaan searches for a way to break his power.

s01e09.description: A genetic scientist offers the crew star charts in exchange for DNA samples, but his experiments and mutilation of Pilot turn the bargain into a nightmare.

s01e10.description: After D'Argo is blasted into space, the crew discovers that Moya's strange behavior is connected to a secret pregnancy.

s01e11.description: Crichton is stranded on a commerce world with a damaged module and becomes entangled with bounty hunters while trying to repair his way back to Moya.

s01e12.description: A group of Delvians draws Zhaan into a dangerous spiritual crisis while Crichton is forced through manipulated memories of Earth and his mother.

s01e13.description: A space trap immobilizes Moya and leaves Crichton and Aeryn stranded together while D'Argo confronts an old Luxan connection.

s01e14.description: Crichton is marooned on an isolated world and slowly builds a new life there, while Moya's crew searches for him and Rygel is mistaken for a ruler.

s01e15.description: Moya collides with a Nebari vessel carrying Rygel's former torturer Durka and the rebellious Chiana, turning an apparent rehabilitation into renewed danger.

s01e16.description: Crichton appears to find a wormhole home to Earth, but the welcome becomes increasingly suspicious as Aeryn and the others are treated as threats.

s01e17.description: A failed Starburst fractures Moya across several realities, forcing Crichton to move between dimensions to reunite the ship and crew.

s01e18.description: An intelligent parasite jumps between bodies aboard Moya just as Peacekeeper commandos arrive, leaving the crew unsure who can be trusted.

s01e19.description: Crichton infiltrates a Peacekeeper medical base to obtain tissue that can save Aeryn and attracts the attention of the calculating Scorpius.

s01e20.description: The crew mounts a rescue inside the Peacekeeper base while Moya gives birth to the armed Leviathan offspring Talyn and Scorpius tightens his pursuit.

s01e21.description: On a jungle world, a seemingly simple murder investigation turns into a struggle for survival among predators, botanists and competing explanations.

s01e22.description: With Crais seeking refuge and Scorpius closing in, Moya's crew prepares a desperate strike against the Peacekeepers while Talyn becomes the key to escape.
